videos.headline: Providence hangs on to upset No. 20 UConn
videos.description: Providence fends off a late UConn rally to earn an upset victory on the road.

videos.headline: Providence's Horchler flies in for putback slam
videos.description: Noah Horchler crashes the offensive glass for a putback dunk vs. UConn.

videos.headline: Croswell stuffs it home through contact for Providence
videos.description: Jared Bynum whips a pass to Ed Croswell, who flushes down a dunk despite being fouled.

videos.headline: Cole, Martin connect for a UConn alley-oop
videos.description: UConn's R.J. Cole tosses a lob up to Tyrese Martin for an alley-oop.
